hypothesis: Sort the aggregate by month and origin with smaller row groups.

queries.routes:
SELECT Dest AS dimension, SUM(n) AS flights, SUM(observed) AS observed_arrivals,
    SUM(delay_sum) AS arrival_delay_minutes,
    SUM(late) AS delayed_flights,
    SUM(cancelled_n) AS cancellations,
    SUM(diverted_n) AS diversions
FROM cache WHERE Month = {{month}} AND Origin = {{origin}}
GROUP BY Dest

materialize.sql:
SELECT Month, Origin, Dest, UniqueCarrier, DayOfWeek, FLOOR(CRSDepTime/100.0) AS departure_hour,
COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(ArrDelay) AS observed, SUM(ArrDelay) AS delay_sum,
SUM(CASE WHEN ArrDelay >= 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late,
SUM(CASE WHEN Cancelled = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_n,
SUM(CASE WHEN Diverted = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS diverted_n
FROM data GROUP BY Month, Origin, Dest, UniqueCarrier, DayOfWeek, FLOOR(CRSDepTime/100.0) ORDER BY Month, Origin
